population: Public itch.io service functionality and published contractual modes; not all observed transactions or individual merchants
unit: Documented service function or payment configuration, not a seller, purchase or paid game
period: Official public terms and creator documentation accessible 2026-10-26; 2026-03-26 policy revision; founder year 2013
sample_frame: Official itch.io terms, privacy policy, general FAQ, creator getting-started, indexing, purchase, payments and download-key documentation

functional_roles.responsible: publisher provides/uploads a project and its assets; itch.io provides publication interface
itch.io hosts the project page and uploaded files under the publisher's content license
itch.io sets independent Search & Browse indexing and visibility eligibility
buyers pay through externally integrated PayPal or Stripe gateways under their payment route
itch.io supplies post-purchase entitlement/download access to publisher-provided game builds
Itch Corp. publishes service terms for users and publishers; each publisher warrants distribution rights in submitted content

merchant_of_record_by_mode.tax_handling: seller is responsible for VAT collection/remittance subject to documented optional collection settings

merchant_of_record_by_mode.payment_receipt: platform collects then seller requests payout
merchant_of_record_by_mode.tax_handling: platform handles applicable transaction VAT collection/remittance per documented mode

boundaries.owner_vs_merchant: Legal platform operator is constant across documented modes; merchant of record changes by seller payout configuration.
boundaries.founder_vs_operator: Founder biography is not proof of present legal control or seller contracting identity.
boundaries.rights_vs_payout: Hosting and promotion license does not transfer all publisher intellectual property ownership.

limitations: Official policies describe allowed operation, not evidence that any particular seller or buyer can transact in a specific jurisdiction.
Official public documents do not establish corporate registry standing or current beneficial ownership.
No merchant account, buyer transaction, game downloads, earnings records or geographic eligibility tests were accessed.
The March 2026 privacy revision does not mean every referenced creator rule was newly revised in March 2026.
